AND
Zameen Media (Private) Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, with its
registered office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, MM Alam Road, Gulberg Ill, Lahore, through its duly authorized
representative Mr. Taha Mehmood (hereinafter referred to as the 'Zameen Media" which expression
shall mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns);
AND

with its registered office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, MM Alam Road, Gulberg Ill, Lahore, through

ameen Medallion's initia

WHEREAS
(A)

The Lessor and Zameen Media entered into a lease agreement dated 3rd December,
2018 further amended through First Amendment dated 1st January, 2022 for Shop "A"
measuring 2,375 sq.ft at third floor of the (the "Demised Premises") building located
at Plot of land No._D-1, Block D, North Nazimabad Karachi (the "Lease
Agreement"): and

(B)

The Parties are desirous to novate the Lease Agreement as per the terms and
conditions of this Agreement.

NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants herein contained, the Parties agree
for themselves, their successors and assigns, as follows:
1.

EFFECTIVE DATE

1.1

This Agreement shall be effective from

2.

NOVATIoN

2,1

Zameen Medallion hereby undertakes from the Effective Date to perform the Lease
Agreement and to be bound by Its terms In every way as if Zameen Medallion was, and had
been from the inception, a party to the Lease Agreement in place of the Zameen Media,

2.2

From the Effective Date, all nghts and obligations of Zameen Media under the Lease
Agreement shall vest in and exclusively belong to Zameeri Medallion. The Lessor, as from
the Effective Date, shall be deemed to be in agreement with Zameen Medallion on the same
terms and conditions as it was in agreement with Zameen Media under the Lease Agreement.

2.3

The Lessor hereby releases and discharges Zameen Media from any and all obligations and
liabilities owed to the Zameen Media under the Lease Agreement and accept Zameen
Medallion to be substituted in place of Zameen Media under the Lease Agreement with effect
from the Effective Date.

2.4

Upon signing of the Lease Agreement, Zameen Media deposited an amount of Rs. 570,000/(Rupees Five Hundred Seventy Thousand) as Security Deposit. The Lessor hereby
acknowledges that from the Effective Date, Security Deposit shall be deemed to have been
paid by Zameen Medallion and the same shall be refunded to Zameen Medallion upon expiry
or termination of the Lease Agreement in the manner as set out in the terms and conditions
of the Lease Agreement and this Agreement.

2.5

AU other terms and conditions of the Lease Agreement shall remain the same and shall be
binding on the Lessor and Zameen Medallion with effect from the Effective Date as if Zameen
Medallion was the Lessee mentioned therein.

3.

AMENDMENT

3.1

The Parties agree that the Term of the Lease Agreement is hereby further extended for the
period of three (3) years commencing from the Effective Date and ending on 3l December,
2027 (the "Extended Term").

3.2

During the Extended Term, the Lessee shall pay to the Lessor the Rent in accordance with
the Schedule of Payment appended with this Agreement.

3.3

From the Effective Date, the Lessee shall pay to the Lessor the Maintenance Charges at the
rate of Rs. 21,375/- (9 per sq. ft). for the provision of maintenance services by the Lessor as
detailed under clause 8.9 of the Lease Agreement.

4.

GENERAL

4.1

The Lease Agreement as is being novated and amended in terms of this Agreement, and
shall be read in conjunction with this Agreement and the clauses, terms, conditions and
covenants contained herein shall now on forth govern the relationship between the Parties.
Moreover, in case of an inconsistency between the contents of the Lease Agreement and
this Agreement it is understood that this Agreement shall always be deemed to prevail.

4.2

This Agreement shall be governed by, construed and take effect in accordance with laws of
the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

4.3

All defined terms used herein shall have the same meaning as ascribed to them in the Lease
Agreement unless otherwise defined herein.

4.4

This Agreement shall be executed in three counterparts, each of which shall be deemed as
original, and the counterparts shall constitute one and the same document for each party.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties have signed the Agreement, having fully understood the
conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses on the day and year first
above written.
